draft.emotion: excited and anticipating a journey, looking forward to seeing new sights
notes: Refers specifically to leisure travel, sightseeing, and tourism. Compare with 旅行 (lǚxíng), which focuses more on the journey itself.
Often follows 去 + place: 去北京旅游 (go to Beijing for a trip).
